text:
No dataset in this evidence shows forest on the property in 2020. The JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 (V4) map, the 2020 forest/non-forest reference, reports 0 ha of forest, or 0% of the asset (2,843.1 ha).

Other evidence points to earlier tree cover:
- Hansen Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13) shows 23 ha of tree cover (≥30% canopy) in 2000.
- Hansen also records tree-cover loss events before the 2020-12-31 baseline: 0.8 ha in 2008, 25.5 ha in 2015, 4.8 ha in 2017 and 67.7 ha in 2020.

These show trees existed and were lost before the baseline. They do not show forest standing in 2020. The loss figures also exceed the 23 ha of 2000 tree cover, and the evidence doesn't explain why, so I can't reconcile them.

The evidence doesn't support a regulatory conclusion either way.
